propositions: A new peer confirmation store must persist records of managed link confirmations with full metadata (link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, source) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation).

The outbound ADD dispatch path must invoke a link_confirm callback after set_relationship succeeds to record confirmation, extracting the vendor link_id from the returned mapping and recording nothing for unbound targets.
The confirmation store file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames in reconcile_helpers to survive snapshot compaction and ensure confirmation-only changes are committed.
A link_confirm callback that raises must be logged and swallowed without affecting the outbound link count or pass behavior, preserving existing counter semantics.
The store must fail-open on corrupt or absent files, degrading to nothing confirmed rather than aborting the pass.
With link_confirm=None, the dispatch behavior and link counters must remain byte-for-byte identical to pre-change behavior on all paths (success, failure, dedup-skip).
